Rules:
- Propose at most 3 things, the most valuable first. Cite the ids of the facts each one relies on.
- Use numbers exactly as they appear in the facts you cite (rounding is fine). Never compute new numbers.

proposal.summary: The data_upsell campaign has clearly positive past results over SMS (+0.93 points, 95% +0.76 to +1.09), but all segment comparisons are 'not clearly different', so no narrowing is supported; contact pressure is the main point to consider.

proposals.title: Consider recent contact pressure before sending
proposals.rationale: 26,343 of these lines (25%) got a campaign in the last 7 days, and 1,652 already had 3 or more campaigns in the last 30 days. Review whether these lines should be held back to limit fatigue, though the facts do not show a segment result that justifies excluding them.

proposals.title: Keep the audience as it is
proposals.rationale: Past data bundle upsell results are positive on SMS, and every segment comparison (region, plan tier, device) is not clearly different from the other lines, so there is no evidence to narrow or exclude any segment. Channel is already SMS, which has the strongest supporting results for this type.
